rationale: Both blocking findings from code-review-final.json are resolved by fix-up commit c62290b67, which implements the JIRA reviewer's redesign rather than a minimal patch: the sr-only span is removed from the button entirely (CR-001's concatenation defect is structurally impossible now — the button carries no second text node), and the new test 'does not set aria-describedby on the chat button for unpinned chats' provides the negative-path coverage CR-002 required, adapted to the new aria-describedby/role=img mechanism. The new test 'exposes pinned icon via role=img and links it to the chat button' asserts the button's exact accessible name is 'Test Chat' (no concatenation) and independently confirms the icon carries role=img/aria-label='Pinned'/no aria-hidden per the reviewer's request. No new high-risk issue (security, public API, data loss, build/runtime correctness) was found in the scoped fix-up diff, so no confirmation pass was needed. business_review/standards_review are carried forward unchanged from the prior verdict per the check-round contract; several of those business_review rows describe the superseded sr-only/aria-hidden approach and are stale relative to the new design — that is a plan-drift concern handled separately by sdlc-light sync mode updating plan.md, not a re-derivation this check round performs.
